reason: I would sign up for the free trial, but I'd likely cancel before being charged because I expect an AI companion to offer superficial platitudes rather than deep coping support. When I am overwhelmed by work deadlines, generic or hallucinated advice would just frustrate me more.
objection: What if it hallucinates, gives superficial advice, or doesn't understand my distress?
would_change_my_mind: Concrete proof or demonstrable examples during onboarding showing nuanced, clinician-backed DBT exercises rather than generic chatbot responses.
